prompt: Create a VERY SIMPLE flat educational cartoon illustration sheet, EXACTLY TWO equal panels side by side on a pure white background. Landscape format. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos or borders. Friendly clean picture-book / university teaching illustration, rounded organic outlines, solid colours, almost no shading, no texture, NO realism, NO intricate machinery, NO background scenery. Restrained cheerful teal, soft coral orange, warm yellow and dark navy. LEFT HALF: a simple recognisable Shakey-like wheeled laboratory robot: one tall light grey rectangular body, two dark wheels, a thin mast with one small box camera and round lens, one short antenna. Beside it, a very simple separate old computer with a small screen. At most a few large shapes for each object, no cables, panels, switches or other detailed parts. Robot and computer separated by ample white space. RIGHT HALF: a simple friendly pale blue late-1980s research van in natural slight three-quarter view, two visible wheels, windows, ONE small camera on roof, travelling on one short gently curving grey road stroke. No trees, landscapes, buildings, people or complex sensor rigs. Use very few large readable shapes, clear silhouettes, comfortable proportions. Each drawing should be instantly understood by a ten-year-old and look pleasant next to a warm cartoon character. These are schematic historical evocations, not precise archival reproductions. Generous white space around both illustrations; centre each within its equal half. Make it elegant through simplicity, not sophistication.
